name: Ethan Reed
bio:
Ethan Reed practically grew up in a garage, tinkering with engines alongside his father, a local mechanic in Indianapolis. This early exposure fueled his passion for motorsport, leading him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Purdue. After graduating, Ethan joined a smaller IndyCar team, honing his skills in aerodynamics and vehicle dynamics. His relentless pursuit of performance and innovative problem-solving quickly caught the attention of larger teams. 

Ethan joined Arrow McLaren five years ago, initially as a senior engineer. His technical acumen and ability to motivate his team led to his promotion to Chief Engineer. Ethan is known for his data-driven approach, spending hours analyzing telemetry to optimize performance. He believes in empowering his team to experiment and push boundaries, fostering a culture of innovation that sets Arrow McLaren apart. His calm demeanor under pressure and unwavering loyalty make him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ethan is of average height, with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out slide rule, even though he primarily uses software.
Has a habit of sketching out complex engineering concepts on napkins during lunch.
Insists on listening to classic rock while reviewing data.
